steps.summary: Every size now belongs to a role on one short ladder, so the reading copy leads and nothing inside the article outshouts its headings.

changes.what: The headline is smaller and lighter, at the editorial ceiling of 2.25 × the body
The pull quote no longer outranks the section heading above it
changes.after: 24px italic, the heading's size, parted by regular weight, italic and the bar

changes.what: The author's name stops inheriting the section-heading style and sits under 'Written by'
changes.before: 30px with 72px of space above (leaked from .prose h2)

changes.what: Body text steps into the editorial range; the lead is told apart by leading, not size
changes.after: body 18px / 1.7, lead 18px / 1.85 in the darker tier

changes.what: Font sizes collapse onto one ladder of rem tokens
Two weights instead of four
Small uppercase tracked labels become sentence case
The callout and author bio are set in the reading face like the rest of the prose

steps.summary: The same orange-and-ink palette, with every text and control colour re-picked until it clears its contrast floor in both themes.

changes.what: The orange Subscribe button's label becomes readable
The quietest grey clears 4.5:1 on the warm tinted surface it lands on
Code comments become readable on the dark code block
The email field's placeholder and edge can be seen
The focus ring in the dark footer is no longer orange beside the orange button
Colours typed inline become named tokens

steps.summary: The column narrows to a comfortable line length, the table loses its box, and the contents list stays reachable on tablets and phones.

changes.what: Shorter lines of body text
The data table sits on the page instead of in a card
changes.before: 1px border, 14px radius, shadow, tinted caption strip
changes.after: no frame; rule under the header, 0.5px row dividers, first column flush with the text

changes.what: Category, tags, change figures and the job count share one chip shape
Below 1180px the contents and share rails move into the column instead of vanishing
changes.after: contents as a <details> above the lead; share as a row after the article

changes.what: The pull-quote bar becomes a rounded emphasis rule
More room above the headline, wider side margins on phones
changes.law: layout dials: page top space, gutter

steps.summary: The page goes flat: no drop shadows, the callout becomes a ruled aside, and only the sticky header keeps its frosted glass, now with fallbacks.

changes.what: Drop shadows removed from the article
changes.before: 5 shadowed surfaces (cover, code, table, author card, post-card hover)

changes.what: The callout is an aside with a rule on its edge, not a tinted box
changes.after: 1px orange rule on the leading edge, no fill

changes.what: The frosted header stays readable over the dark cover
changes.before: 82% tint, 14px blur; grey nav text 3.61:1 over the navy cover

changes.what: The header's glass gets its fallbacks
changes.after: opaque baseline, @supports, reduced transparency, more contrast, forced colours

steps.summary: Movement is kept for what it explains: the diagram plays a few laps and rests, and cards no longer jump under the pointer.

changes.what: The cover's data packets stop looping forever
changes.after: 3 laps (7 on the bridge line), about 10s, then rest

changes.what: Related-post cards no longer rise on hover
changes.after: edge darkens, 200ms in · 250ms out, no travel

changes.what: The 'All posts' arrow no longer slides
Buttons press in at once
changes.after: scale 0.96 at 0ms, eased back on release

changes.what: One named curve and a duration ladder replace the default ease

steps.summary: Controls now do what they look like they do: Copy link copies, email shares by email, and the sign-up field is labelled.

changes.what: 'Copy link' is a button that copies the page address and says so
'Share by email' opens an email
changes.after: mailto: with the article title as subject

changes.what: The newsletter field has a visible label
